responsibility: Declares the main visitor for resolving Rust HIR items into TyTy types. In addition to the generic item-resolution entry point, it exposes helpers for resolving impl members and impl self types, and for validating trait impl blocks after substitutions and self types have been computed.
same_name_distinction: Declares the main TypeCheckItem visitor and helper entry points for resolving impl members and impl self types, but not the item-resolution algorithms themselves. Those behaviors are implemented in rust-hir-type-check-item.cc.
